rationale: Both candidates validate the orchestrator's already_submitted fix with reasoning that matches the sole ground-truth inline comment (both submit paths reject list prompts, so the gate was unnecessary), and both independently surface the same significant out-of-scope finding — that super().forward() in pipeline_ming_imagegen.py no longer matches the refactored ZImagePipeline.forward signature — with comparable file/line grounding. Y edges ahead on actionability via literal suggested-diff code blocks and a test skeleton plus more granular CI-check evidence, though its output carries redundant repeated bullets and an irrelevant 'skill candidates' section. X reads cleaner and more calibrated (explicitly hedging the CI-failure claim) but supplies fewer directly-applicable patches.
